Class PluginStatsHandle

java.lang.Object
com.soulfiremc.server.api.metrics.PluginStatsHandle
public final class PluginStatsHandle extends Object

Runtime stats reported by a single plugin within one instance.

Plugins obtain a handle via InstancePluginStats.forPlugin(PluginInfo), then register named counters / gauges and track which bots they are acting on. All operations are thread-safe; plugins typically report from bot threads.
